capabilities: Copy selected text with file path and line numbers
Copy files from the file explorer as path references
Show a floating copy button near the selection
Switch between absolute and vault-relative path modes
disambiguation: Not an export or data-pipeline tool; it only places path- and line-annotated copies of selections on the clipboard.
extras: Manifest carries the 'not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff' notice; no default hotkey is set and users must assign one in settings. Documentation is bilingual (English and Chinese), and output uses Markdown blockquote format so agents can distinguish references from questions.
motivation: The author frequently had to copy the file path and then the selected content in two steps when using terminal CLI agents, and built the plugin to do both in one copy action.
problem: With CLI-based AI agent tools, users must copy the document path and the selected text separately because the terminal workflow lacks the seamless selection-sharing of GUI agent tools.

relations.evidence: paste directly into AI agent terminals (Claude Code, etc.)

summary: Copies selected text or files from Obsidian with file path and line numbers, formatted for pasting into terminal AI agents like Claude Code.
